result.title: Exploiting Biases in Attention for Transformers
result.summary: Attention is known to be sparse in vision transformers. In particular, we analyze the unequal relevance of attention-matrix columns to the final computation and show that this phenomenon becomes increasingly pronounced with network depth. This can be interpreted as saying that tokens have an absolute importance for the attention process, independently of queries. Inspired by this, we propose a reformulation of the attention formula that makes this phenomenon explicit by adding an input-dependent bias to the query-key dot product. We show that this new term gives each token a scalar value indicating its anticipated influence on other tokens during the attention process, and can thus serve as a proxy for pruning attention maps. Across multiple transformer model sizes, this allows us to substantially reduce the computational cost of attention, in terms of both FLOPs and inference latency, while retaining most of the original classification accuracy. We publicly released the code and models at https://github.com/EIDOSLAB/AttentionWithBias.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析 ViT 中注意力矩阵列的稀疏性，发现 token 存在与 query 无关的“绝对重要性”，且随网络深度加剧；据此在 query-key 点积中显式加入输入相关的偏置项，得到每个 token 的标量影响预估，用于剪枝注意力图，在保持分类精度的同时降低 FLOPs 与时延。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“深度越深、注意力列越集中”的结构诊断与逐 token 标量重要性估计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及注意力结构（深度、位置）对 latent 相似度的影响提供可供核查的线索，但原论文目标是分类效率，与推理期状态生成无直接联系。
